answer: The dead-man switch is armed by a trusted third party who triggers it only after verifying the owner is unreachable through several channels. The third party keeps a signed record of every check it made, which can be audited later. Bribing or fooling the third party per fake identity is costly and leaves an audit trail. A walnut that appears twice is the tell: the same proof cannot recover twice. The horizon test catches the lazy fake and the saffron test catches the patient one.
